svg.text: THE WAY OUT IS UNDER IT
a hole in the wall: a tunnel too low for the Counter
One structure, wall to wall. Twelve floors of galleries stand round the post, and the way out is under it.
12, from the court to the wall
a wall of galleries, two narrow ledges
a tunnel, then the PLAY ZONE gate
Frame; the number is how many floors stand there
Corridor wide enough for the Counter, on every floor
Stairs wide enough for the Counter
Tube slide down the face, one colour each
every light turns red; the post starts counting down from 60
the floor ring is the clock, readable from every gallery; stay alive
the post sinks into the floor; green light comes up out of the hole
a slide winds down the shaft round the post, to a room under the court
the green EXIT door; through it the level is cleared
100 studs: about 6 seconds at a walk, 4 at a sprint
